task.title: Filter corpus samples by verified outcome
task.objective: Select records by the exact aggregate outcome.verified decision without inferring it from individual verification checks
acceptance_criteria: The verified option accepts exactly true or false
Matching uses the aggregate outcome.verified boolean
Per-check status does not override the aggregate predicate
The predicate composes with existing filters before the limit

attempts.summary: Added behavior coverage for true, false, composition, invalid input, and malformed corpus records
attempts.diagnostic: Clap rejected the unimplemented verified option

attempts.summary: Added strict boolean parsing and exact aggregate outcome matching

outcome.summary: Corpus samples can be filtered by the explicit aggregate verification decision independently of per-check status

lessons: Aggregate decisions and component evidence require separate explicit predicates
Boolean filters should reject non-boolean values before corpus access
